test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements regarding the National Civil Services Day 2026 is INCORRECT?

options.text: The day is observed annually on April 21 and was officially established in the year 2006.
The theme for the 18th edition in 2026 is "Viksit Bharat: Citizen-Centric Governance and Development at the Last Mile".
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel originally addressed the civil servants and called them the "steel frame of India" at Vigyan Bhawan.
Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan conferred the Prime Minister’s Awards for Excellence in Public Administration 2025 during the event.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel originally addressed the civil servants and called them the "steel frame of India" at Vigyan Bhawan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **National Civil Services Day** is observed annually on **April 21** to honor civil servants' dedication to governance.
 
• The **18th edition in 2026** was celebrated in **New Delhi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement claiming that Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel delivered his 1947 address at Vigyan Bhawan is **incorrect**. He delivered his historic **1947 address** at **Metcalfe House, Delhi**, where he dubbed civil servants the "**steel frame of India**".
 
• The **2026 events** were held at **Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi**, making the location in the incorrect option factually wrong for Patel's historical address.
 
• The **theme** for the 18th edition in 2026 is "**Viksit Bharat: Citizen-Centric Governance and Development at the Last Mile**", making the related statement correct.
 
• The day was officially **established in 2006** to commemorate Patel’s historic address, making that statement correct.
 
• During the 2026 event, **Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan** served as the Chief Guest and conferred the **Prime Minister’s Awards for Excellence in Public Administration 2025**, making the fourth statement correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The primary objective of the day is to recognize the efforts of public servants, provide a platform for evaluating performance, and encourage a renewed dedication to public welfare and effective administration.
 
• The **Prime Minister’s Awards for Excellence in Public Administration** are presented to honor outstanding public service and groundbreaking initiatives.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Date of Observance:** April 21
 
• **2026 Edition:** 18th Anniversary
 
• **Chief Guest (2026):** Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan
 
• **Theme (2026):** Viksit Bharat: Citizen-Centric Governance and Development at the Last Mile
